title: Rectangle Class
hints: Methods use the object's own fields: int area() { return width * height; }
isSquare() can return the comparison directly: return width == height;
Joining a boolean with text prints true or false.

mustContain.message: Give Rectangle a method int area().
Give Rectangle a method int perimeter().
Give Rectangle a method boolean isSquare().
